entities.name: Siddhartha Gautama (Buddha)
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Indian spiritual teacher (c. 563–483 BCE) who achieved enlightenment and founded Buddhism. His teachings on suffering, impermanence, and the path to nirvana became one of the world's major religions.
